name: Forgive and Forget
source:
Ayame used to be your best friend, the one who made school bearable. But when she became your enemy, you ran away and shut yourself in. Still, you can feel that something isn’t right…

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=20990]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
绫雨曾经是你最好的朋友，是他让你在学校里变得可以忍受。但当她成为你的敌人时，你却逃跑了，将自己封闭起来。但你还是感觉有些不对劲……
